subject_lessons.title: Y10 Math (Geometry & Trig): Unit Circle (sin, cos, atan2) & Directed Graphs
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL GEOMETRY & TRIGONOMETRY LESSON (GRADE 10):
• Unit Circle Trigonometry: A ray at angle `θ` (in radians) has direction vector `(cos θ, sin θ)`.
• Inverse Tangent `atan2(dy, dx)` recovers the exact angle `θ ∈ [-π, π]` from any `(dx, dy)` displacement.
• Graph Theory: A feed-forward neural network is a Directed Acyclic Graph `G = (V, E)` with vertices (neurons) and weighted edges (synapses).

# 📐 YEAR 10 TRIGONOMETRY LAB: Unit Circle Ray Projection
import math
car_x, car_y, heading = 320.0, 210.0, math.pi / 4.0  # 45 degrees
dist = 100.0
end_x = car_x + dist * math.cos(heading)
end_y = car_y + dist * math.sin(heading)
recovered_angle = math.atan2(end_y - car_y, end_x - car_x)
print(f'Ray Endpoint: ({end_x:.1f}, {end_y:.1f}) | Angle: { math.degrees(recovered_angle):.1f} deg')

subject_lessons.title: Y10 Chemistry: Stoichiometry, Activation Energy Barriers & Reaction Kinetics
subject_lessons.story:
TRADITIONAL CHEMISTRY LESSON (GRADE 10):
• Conservation of Mass (Stoichiometry): In a balanced chemical reaction (like rocket propellant `2H₂ + O₂ -> 2H₂O`), the number of atoms of each element is conserved.
• Activation Energy (`E_a`): A reaction requires an energy threshold to fire—analogous to a neuron's activation threshold!

TRADITIONAL LANGUAGE ARTS LESSON (GRADE 10):
• Deductive Reasoning moves from general axioms/theorems to specific guaranteed conclusions (like geometric proofs and Safety Shield rules).
• Inductive Reasoning generalizes patterns from empirical observations (which is how Machine Learning trains from examples!).

# 🤖 YEAR 10 AI CAPSTONE: NEAT Speciation & Crossover
from workbench.labs.neat_core import NEATPopulation, NEATGenome

pop = NEATPopulation(num_inputs=6, num_outputs=2, pop_size=20)
g1, g2 = pop.genomes[0], pop.genomes[1]
g1.mutate_add_node(pop.tracker)
dist = NEATGenome.compatibility_distance(g1, g2)
child = NEATGenome.crossover(g1, g2)
print(f'Speciation Compatibility Distance: {dist:.3f} | Child Nodes: {len(child.nodes)}')
